caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic vessel with two small, slightly curved handles on either side near the top. The body of the vessel is light tan or beige in color, and there are two prominent, roughly circular brown spots on its surface. Around the upper section, below the rim, a dark blue wavy line forms a band that encircles the vessel. Below this band, a floral motif with leaves and flowers, rendered in dark blue, extends vertically along the front of the vessel. Near the base, there is a circular opening with a raised rim that is outlined with a broad dark blue ring. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the vessel in the foreground.
title: Water Cooler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
